get_unread_people.description: Get the list of conversation members who have not read the given message yet. Changes nothing.

get_task_unread_people.description: Get the list of task participants who have not read the given task message yet. Changes nothing.

get_application_unread_people.description: Get the list of gamemasters and players who have not read the given application comment yet. Changes nothing.

params.obj_id: ID of the message in the application conversation

get_vote.description: Get the list of users who voted for a message with the given option. Changes nothing.

params.value: The vote option the voters are selected by

get_important.description: Get the list of users who marked the object as important. Changes nothing.

params.obj_type: Object type: message, task, application and other site object types

get_authors.description: Get the list of the object owners — users holding administrator rights on it. Changes nothing.

params.obj_type: Object type: project, community, task and other site object types

show_user_info.description: Get a short user card, limited by the rights of the viewer. Changes nothing.

params.obj_type: Display context: roleslist — from the project role list, anything else — a regular card
params.value: ID of the project the display rights are checked against

show_user_info_from_rolelist.description: Same as show_user_info, but called from the embeddable project role list. Changes nothing.

params.obj_type: Display context: roleslist — from the project role list, anything else — a regular card
params.value: ID of the project the display rights are checked against
